description: This file defines a Buttons class for managing toolbar buttons in the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, including button creation, state updates, and event handling.

classes.name: Buttons
classes.description: Class managing toolbar buttons for Summernote editor, including initialization, button creation, state updates, and event handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes Buttons instance with context, setting up UI, options, language, and key mappings.

methods.name: representShortcut
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a keyboard shortcut for a given editor method, with platform-specific symbols.

methods.name: button
methods.description: Creates a button UI element with given options, handling tooltip deletion if needed.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up toolbar buttons, image, link, and table popover buttons, and initializes font map.

methods.name: isFontInstalled
methods.description: Checks if a font is installed or ignored, caching results.

methods.name: isFontDeservedToAdd
methods.description: Determines if a font should be added to font options, excluding generic families.

methods.name: addToolbarButtons
methods.description: Creates and memoizes toolbar buttons for formatting, styles, lists, alignment, table, media, and other actions.

methods.name: addImagePopoverButtons
methods.description: Creates buttons for image resizing, floating, and removal.

methods.name: addLinkPopoverButtons
methods.description: Creates buttons for editing and removing links.

methods.name: addTablePopoverButtons
methods.description: Creates buttons for table row/column addition and deletion.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds button groups into a container based on provided group definitions.

methods.name: updateCurrentStyle
methods.description: Updates button states based on current editor style, including font, size, and line height.

methods.name: updateBtnStates
methods.description: Updates button active states based on provided predicate functions.

methods.name: tableMoveHandler
methods.description: Handles mouse movement over table dimension picker to visually highlight table size.
